international.title: Spuds in space: scientists say potatoes could be key food source for future moon base
international.summary: New report finds that potatoes should be able to grow on moon after they were successfully cultivated in simulated lunar soil The humble potato could be the key to sustaining human life on the moon , according to a new scientific report asserting that prolonged lunar exploration will depend on life support systems capable of producing food there. Potatoes are an ideal candidate for farming on the moon, scientists on a project backed by the US space agency Nasa concluded, after they succeeded in growing them in simulated lunar soil.
